meta.title: Young in Directive 8020 — Pilot
meta.description: Brianna Young — Pilot. A Cassiopeia pilot and the daughter of astronaut Bill Young.
meta.ogDescription: Brianna Young — Pilot. A Cassiopeia pilot and the daughter of astronaut Bill Young.

blocks.text: Brianna Young pilots the Cassiopeia and grew up wanting to follow her father, astronaut Bill Young, into spaceflight. Her official profile describes strong flight-school results and a competitive streak that also showed on Corinth’s football team. The mission is a chance to test the abilities she has worked to develop.

After Bill’s death, Young concentrated even more on training. Nolan Stafford became her mentor and a father figure. Their shared history explains a relationship aboard the ship; it does not establish which choices save either character. Lashana Lynch is the performer identified for Young by the official game presentation.
